blocks.text: Enforcement of Title Ⅵ of the Civil Rights Act of 1964
DOJ recommends an analysis of four factors:

1. Identifying the number or proportion of LEP persons
eligible to be served or likely to be encountered by the
program or grantee
2. Frequency with which LEP individuals come in contact
with the program
3. Nature and importance of the program,activity, or service
4. Resources available to the grantee/recipient and costs

* Initial guidance document published January 16, 2001; revised version
  went into effect June 12, 2002
